inputs.original_text: Martin is waving around increased tenancies to make things look better, while eviction notices, homelessness and emergency accommodation are all rising. The six-year lease rules introduced by the Government on March 1 look less like a solution and more like part of the machinery shaping the story: spotlight the number of tenancies, and people may stop asking who is being forced out—and whose interests that serves.
inputs.modified_text: Martin is pointing to more tenancies as a distraction while eviction notices, homelessness and emergency accommodation are all rising. The six-year lease rules introduced by the Government on March 1 look like part of the same managed narrative: promote a flattering number, keep attention off the people being pushed out, and protect the interests behind it. Don’t mistake the headline figure for the full story.
